_help: Copy to alert_filters.json and edit. Only emails matching watch_query are ever touched. Rule fields: from, to, subject, body (a word or list of words, case-insensitive, any word matches), subject_regex, body_regex, has_attachment. All fields in one rule must match. folders are checked first and move matching emails into their own label (never discarded). Set dry_run to false once the log shows the right decisions.
watch_query: in:inbox subject:(alert OR alarm OR warning OR critical OR incident)
